Record Class FlightComputerController

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
info.openrocket.core.simulation.flightcomputer.FlightComputerController
public record FlightComputerController(jakarta.json.JsonObject json) extends Record
Immutable portable controller definition; all control angles/rates use degrees, time uses microseconds.
